title: ACPI RSDP (Root System Description Pointer)
summary: The ACPI RSDP is located in the BIOS/UEFI memory (searched in EBDA and 0xE0000-0xFFFFF). It points to the RSDT (ACPI 1.0) or XSDT (ACPI 2.0+). Structure (ACPI 1.0, 20 bytes): signature 'RSD PTR ' (8 bytes), checksum (1), OEM ID (6), revision (1), RsdtAddress (4). ACPI 2.0+ extends to 36 bytes with XsdtAddress (8), extended checksum (1), reserved (3).

structure.meaning: Sum of all bytes in the RSDP (ACPI 1.0) must be 0 mod 256.
Length of the RSDP (36 for ACPI 2.0+).
Sum of all bytes in the extended RSDP (36 bytes) must be 0 mod 256.

notes: ACPI (Advanced Configuration and Power Interface) is the standard for OS-directed power management and hardware enumeration.
RSDT/XSDT point to other ACPI tables: MADT (APIC), FADT (fixed ACPI), DSDT (differentiated system description), SSDT (secondary), MCFG (PCIe MMCONFIG), HPET, etc.
ACPI tables are written in AML (ACPI Machine Language) and interpreted by the OS.
ACPI is essential for booting modern x86/ARM systems.
